title: Kantha Running Stitch Quilt
tagline: The running-stitch quilting of Bengal: sew each patch with the fewest threads.
description: Sew cloth patches in running stitch, one chalk row at a time. Your thread is only so long, so plan every hop and make it last. Hints that teach, Watch and Learn, a Daily Patch and a calm timing game called Steady Hand. Portrait or landscape.
howToPlay: Tap the end of a chalk row, then tap it again to sew the whole row.
The thread is only so long and each hop under the cloth uses some.
When a row does not fit, or is another colour, a new thread begins.
Sew every row with as few threads as you can: three stars is the fewest.
Tap the lamp for a hint that shows where to look, then why.
In Steady Hand, tap as the needle reaches each mark for even stitches.
